q: In which land did Job, the blameless and upright man, live?
why: He feared God and shunned evil.
quote: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job.

q: How does the Bible describe Job before his troubles began?
quote: And this man was blameless and upright, fearing God and shunning evil.

q: Before his troubles, how many sons and daughters did Job have?
quote: He had seven sons and three daughters

q: After losing everything, what did Job say about the LORD?
a: The LORD gave and has taken
quote: The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.

q: In all his early losses, what did Job not do?
quote: In all this, Job did not sin or charge God with wrongdoing.

q: After losing his family and wealth, what covered Job's body?
why: From his feet to his head.
quote: and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

q: When Job's three friends first came, how long did they sit with him silently?
quote: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, but no one spoke a word to him

q: How did the LORD finally answer Job?
quote: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind

q: At the end of Job's story, how much did the LORD give him?
why: This came after he prayed for his friends.
quote: the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.

q: What did the LORD say about Job to Satan?
a: No one on earth is like him
quote: For there is no one on earth like him

q: When God let Satan test Job, what could Satan not touch at first?
quote: but you must not lay a hand on the man himself.

q: After hearing all his losses, what did Job do after tearing his robe?
quote: He fell to the ground and worshiped

q: What struck the house where Job's children were eating?
quote: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house.

q: Who told suffering Job, “Curse God and die!”?
quote: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”

q: What did Job ask his wife about accepting from God?
why: He did not sin in what he said.
quote: Should we accept from God only good and not adversity?

q: Sitting among the ashes, what did Job use to scrape his sores?
quote: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes.

q: In his suffering, what did Job say he knows?
quote: But I know that my Redeemer lives

q: What did God ask Job about the earth's foundations?
quote: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?

q: After God spoke to him, what did Job say had changed?
a: Now my eyes have seen You
why: He had only heard of God before.
quote: My ears had heard of You, but now my eyes have seen You.

q: In the book of Job, what is called wisdom?
quote: Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom

q: Why was the LORD angry with Job's friends?
quote: For you have not spoken about Me accurately, as My servant Job has.

q: Which of these was one of Job's three friends?
why: The others were Eliphaz and Zophar.
quote: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite

q: Before his troubles, how many camels did Job own?
quote: and he owned 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels

q: Which younger man grew angry at Job for justifying himself rather than God?
why: He was the son of Barachel.
quote: This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite

q: What was the name of Job's first daughter after his restoration?
why: The others were Keziah and Keren-happuch.
quote: He named his first daughter Jemimah

q: How many more years did Job live after his restoration?
quote: After this, Job lived 140 years

q: God asked Job if he could loosen the belt of which constellation?
quote: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?

q: Which raiders took Job's oxen and donkeys?
quote: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away.

q: When Job's family came to comfort him, what did each give him?
why: They ate with him in his house.
quote: And each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.
